includeWorkflowState.description: Include the saved workflow snapshot (default: true). Set false to omit block configuration from a log read. Other run fields are unchanged.

query.title: Execution log detail options
query.description: Controls whether a log detail read includes its saved workflow snapshot.

id.description: Identifier to address this file by on the download endpoint.

type.description: MIME type recorded for the file.

downloadPath.description: Path to fetch this file's bytes from, relative to the API host.

V2LogFile.title: Execution log file
V2LogFile.description: A file produced by the run this log records.

LogTraceSpan.title: Log trace span
LogTraceSpan.description: One recursive operation span in a workflow execution trace.

durationMs.description: Compatibility field for span duration in milliseconds. Read `duration` for current trace spans.

errorHandled.description: Whether the recorded error was handled.

blockId.description: Workflow block associated with the span.

input.description: Input captured for the traced operation.

output.description: Output captured for the traced operation.

anyOf.description: Total tokens attributed to the span.

tokens.description: Token usage attributed to the span.

relativeStartMs.description: Offset from the root span in milliseconds.

arguments.description: Arguments supplied to the tool call.

result.description: Value returned by the tool call.

toolCalls.description: Tool calls recorded by the span.

workflowId.description: Workflow identifier, or null when unavailable.

deploymentVersionId.description: Deployment version identifier, or null when unavailable.

status.description: Current execution status, reported as persisted. `redacting` is transient while run output is scrubbed. `paused` is reported only when a resume attempt did not complete; a run held at a human-in-the-loop pause point reads `pending` here, and `paused` on the workflow run resources. Use those when the pause state matters.

endedAt.description: ISO 8601 execution end timestamp, or null while the run is active.

totalDurationMs.description: Total execution duration in milliseconds, or null while unavailable.

files.description: Files the run produced, or null when none are recorded. Only the run's own output files appear; input attachments a caller supplied are addressed through the files API instead.

executedByEmail.description: Email of the identity the run executed as: the caller for an interactive or personal-API-key run, and the workspace billing account for a schedule, webhook, deployed chat, or public API call. Null when the run failed before an identity was resolved.

id.description: Workflow identifier, or null when unavailable.

description.description: Workflow description, or null when unset.

anyOf.title: Folder path
anyOf.description: Canonical slash-prefixed folder path. `/` is the workspace root. Segments are percent-encoded, so a folder shown as "New folder" is `/New%20folder`: everything outside `A-Z a-z 0-9 - _ . ~` is escaped as uppercase hex, and only that exact encoding is accepted. A trailing slash, an empty segment, and a literal `.` or `..` segment are rejected. At most 64 segments and 4096 encoded bytes.

folderPath.description: Canonical folder path of the workflow, in the same form `folderPaths` accepts as a filter: `/` for a workflow at the workspace root. Null only when the path cannot be resolved — the folder has been deleted, or the workflow itself no longer exists.

ownerEmail.description: Deprecated — use the run-level `executedByEmail` instead. Email of the workflow's current owner, or null when unavailable. This is a property of the workflow as it stands today, not of the run: it changes when workflow ownership is reassigned, and the owner is not the identity a background run executes as.

workspaceId.description: Owning workspace identifier, or null when unavailable.

createdAt.description: ISO 8601 workflow creation timestamp, or null when unavailable.

updatedAt.description: ISO 8601 workflow update timestamp, or null when unavailable.

deleted.description: Whether the workflow has been deleted.

workflow.description: Workflow snapshot associated with the execution.

additionalProperties.description: One top-level snapshot section — `blocks`, `edges`, `loops`, `parallels`, or `variables` — passed through as stored.

workflowState.description: Workflow graph captured for the run, or null if unavailable or includeWorkflowState=false. Sensitive values are redacted to null; environment-variable references may be preserved.

finalOutput.description: Materialized final workflow output, or null when none was produced.

category.description: What the line is for: the run's base fee (`fixed`), one model's inference (`model`), or one metered tool or integration call (`tool`).

description.description: Human-readable name of the billed item, such as the model or tool id.

cost.description: Amount billed for this line, in USD.

inputTokens.description: Input tokens attributed to this line. Absent for lines that do not bill tokens.

outputTokens.description: Output tokens attributed to this line. Absent for lines that do not bill tokens.

items.description: One billed line of a run, folded across every event that billed it.
Billed lines reconciling to `total`, or null when no itemized ledger exists for the run.

cost.description: Cost charged for the run, or null when unavailable.

anyOf.description: Caller-supplied trigger payload for the run.

workflowInput.description: Input the run was triggered with, or null when the run recorded none. Credential-bearing and PII-masked values are redacted the same way `finalOutput` is.

V2LogDetail.title: Execution log detail
V2LogDetail.description: Detailed workflow execution log including state, trace, output, and cost.

workspaceId.description: Workspace whose execution logs should be returned.

workflowIds.description: Comma-separated workflow identifiers to include. An empty entry is rejected. At most 200 entries.

triggers.description: Comma-separated, lowercase trigger types or webhook provider IDs. Matching is exact and case-sensitive; unknown values select no runs. An empty entry is rejected. The sentinel `all` disables this filter, even when listed with other values. At most 100 entries.

startDate.description: Only include runs started at or after this UTC ISO 8601 timestamp, e.g. `2026-08-06T00:00:00Z`. A date without a time, or a timestamp carrying a UTC offset instead of `Z`, is rejected, as is year `0000`, which names no storable instant.

endDate.description: Only include runs started at or before this UTC ISO 8601 timestamp, e.g. `2026-08-06T00:00:00Z`. A date without a time, or a timestamp carrying a UTC offset instead of `Z`, is rejected, as is year `0000`, which names no storable instant.

minDurationMs.description: Minimum total execution duration in milliseconds. Whole milliseconds from 0 to 2147483647; the stored duration is a 32-bit integer, so a fractional or out-of-range bound is rejected.

maxDurationMs.description: Maximum total execution duration in milliseconds. Whole milliseconds from 0 to 2147483647; the stored duration is a 32-bit integer, so a fractional or out-of-range bound is rejected.

minCost.description: Minimum execution cost in USD, from 0 to 1000000. A run is never charged a negative amount, so a negative bound is rejected rather than treated as a filter that matches every run.

maxCost.description: Maximum execution cost in USD, from 0 to 1000000. A run is never charged a negative amount, so a negative bound is rejected rather than treated as a filter that matches every run.

details.description: Response detail level. `full` adds the `workflow` summary to every workflow run; a job run never carries one, whatever this is set to. `includeTraceSpans=true` and `includeFinalOutput=true` each imply `full`, so either one adds `workflow` even when `details=basic` is sent explicitly.

includeTraceSpans.description: Whether to include block-level trace spans. Implies `details=full`. Spans are pruned on their own retention schedule, so a run whose spans have aged out returns `traceSpans: []` rather than an error.

includeFinalOutput.description: Whether to include the final workflow output. Implies `details=full`, so the `workflow` summary is present regardless of what `details` is set to.

limit.description: Maximum log entries per page. Values outside 1–1000 are truncated and clamped into that range rather than rejected. Defaults to 100.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor from the previous page. Send it back with the same sort and filters; only `limit` may change. Change anything else and pagination must restart without a cursor.

includeHandledErrors.description: Whether `level=error` also selects runs that finished at `info` after a block error was recovered by an error path. Off by default: such a run succeeded, so it is an error only to a caller auditing error handling. Every row reports `hasHandledErrors` whether or not this is set. Job runs carry no block trace, so the flag never widens that branch.

status.description: Comma-separated execution statuses to include, from `pending` | `running` | `paused` | `redacting` | `completed` | `failed` | `cancelled`. An empty entry is rejected. ANDed with `level`, which reports severity rather than lifecycle.

workflowName.description: Case-insensitive substring match against the run's workflow name. Runs whose workflow has been deleted match nothing, because the name is no longer joinable.

includeJobRuns.description: Include Chat and Sim-agent jobs alongside workflow runs. Jobs use `kind: "job"` and have no workflow or cost ledger. Workflow, folder, model, or status filters exclude jobs. This option is valid only when sorting by `startedAt`.

sortBy.description: Field used to sort the result. `durationMs` and `cost` are null until a run settles; those runs sort before recorded values in ascending order and after them in descending order. Only `startedAt` can order Chat and Sim-agent job runs, so any other value is rejected when job runs are included.

folderPaths.description: Comma-separated workflow folder paths, including descendants. Up to 100 paths. Unknown folder paths contribute no matches.

nextCursor.description: Opaque cursor for the next page. Send it back as `cursor`; `null` means there are no more pages. Do not construct a cursor yourself.

kind.description: Whether the run executed a workflow or a Chat / Sim-agent job. Job runs appear only when `includeJobRuns=true`.

workflowId.description: Workflow identifier, or null when unavailable.

deploymentVersionId.description: Deployment version identifier, or null when unavailable.

status.description: Current execution status, reported as persisted. `redacting` is transient while run output is scrubbed. `paused` is reported only when a resume attempt did not complete; a run held at a human-in-the-loop pause point reads `pending` here, and `paused` on the workflow run resources. Use those when the pause state matters.

endedAt.description: ISO 8601 execution end timestamp, or null while the run is active.

totalDurationMs.description: Total execution duration in milliseconds, or null while unavailable.

cost.description: Cost charged for the run, or null when the run has neither a recorded total nor an itemized ledger.

files.description: Files the run produced, or null when none are recorded. Only the run's own output files appear; input attachments a caller supplied are addressed through the files API instead.

hasHandledErrors.description: Whether a block in the run errored and was recovered by an error path. Such a run keeps `level: info`, so this is the only place the handled error shows at run level; pass `includeHandledErrors=true` with `level=error` to list these runs. Always false for a job run.

id.description: Workflow identifier, or null when unavailable.

description.description: Workflow description, or null when unset.

deleted.description: Whether the workflow has been deleted.

workflow.description: Workflow summary for a full-detail result.
